messages:
alex: Posting follow-ups from yesterday's DR postmortem. TL;DR — we've got 6 follow-ups around multi-region routing, backups, restore runbooks, and a game-day. Need clear owners, timelines, and a plan for recurring checks. See the list I pulled from the notes below.

alex: Action items (short):
1) Add cross-region routing health check + automated failover policy (needs playbook)
2) Formalize S3/GCS backup verification + retention audit
3) Restore runbook: step-by-step with exact commands and verification steps (include db/kv/cache)
4) Schedule quarterly DR game-day + smoke tests in staging and prod-sim
5) Add routing telemetry & alert thresholds (pay attention to 429s + partial region timeouts)
6) Postmortem follow-ups aggregated to a single tracker and linked to JIRAs

alex: Please reply with owner + ETA (week or date) and whether you need more context.

sam: I'll take #1 (routing health check + failover policy). Targeting EOW next week to have a first-draft playbook. Will need a quick sync with eng-network to confirm BGP/edge behavior.

jiwoo: I'll own #2 (backup verification + retention). Plan: run audit job across all buckets by 04/15, and implement integrity-check lambda by 05/01.

maria: I'll pick up #3 (restore runbook). I'll assemble a checklist today and aim for a dry-run doc by 04/07. Need clarity on which snapshots we consider golden for restore tests. @jiwoo can you confirm backup snapshot naming?

jiwoo: @maria yes — backups use the pattern `redwood-prod-<region>-snap-YYYYMMDD`. I can provide the last 90 days list and a sample restore snapshot for the dry-run.

devin: For #4 (game-day), I can schedule the first DR game-day during the week of 04/20 — prefer Tue/Wed mornings. We'll run a reduced-impact failover in staging and a simulated partial-region outage in prod-sim. Suggest we include devex, SRE, and one product on-call.

alex: Great. @devin please put a calendar hold and draft an agenda. Include a pre-game checklist: backups verified, runbook ready, rollback steps tested.

sam: For #5 (routing telemetry), I'll create a proposal: add per-region 95th/99th latency and 429 rate alerts to the console. ETA: proposal by 04/09, instrumentation by 04/30.

maria: For #3 verification steps, I'll add: restore DB from snapshot -> verify KV sync -> run integration smoke -> warm caches -> promote. I'll post the runbook snippet in the doc with exact `pg_restore` and cache-warm commands.

opsbot: Reminder: Incident DR-2026-03-18 postmortem created and labeled `dr-followup`. Tracker created at https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/DRF-286.

alex: Adding one more: recurring incident pattern — we saw routing table warmup failures when capacity shifts happened. We should add a weekly regression test that simulates route-flapping and check failing-over behavior in the routing shim. Who can help add that to the scheduler?

sam: I'll add the route-flap simulator harness to our CI pipeline. ETA: prototype by 04/12.

jiwoo: I'll run the backup audit and share results in this thread when done.

maria: I'll post the runbook link in #docs once it's ready and tag the runbook with a checklist.

alex: Okay: owners/ETAs consolidated: #1 sam EOW 04/03 draft, #2 jiwoo 04/15 audit, #3 maria 04/07 dry-run doc, #4 devin week of 04/20, #5 sam proposal 04/09 instrumentation by 04/30, #6 alex to aggregate JIRAs (DRF-286 root). If anything slips, mark blockers in the tracker.

devin: I've created a draft calendar invite and agenda, linked to DRF-286. Invite includes SRE, eng-network, product-oncall.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

jiwoo: ack, starting audit today.

maria: ack, will DM @alex if I need snapshot access.

alex: Thanks all. I'll close the loop after I link each action to a JIRA ticket and add ETA fields to DRF-286. Please update the tracker when you make progress.

devin: quick Q — should the quarterly game-day be mandatory for all on-call teams or optional with delegates? I'd vote mandatory for at least one engineer from each team.

alex: Mandatory for one engineer per team + product owner. We'll circulate dates and rotate leads.

sam: small note — for failover policy we should include a fallback to older quantized model variants (recent outage showed increased tail latency when new model rolled). Adding that to playbook.

alex: Good catch. Add as sub-item in playbook.

opsbot: Reminder set: DR game-day prep check 04/14 09:00 UTC.

maria: Saved — I'm blocking time to run the dry-run on 04/07.

alex: If no objections, I'll mark this thread closed and move tasks into the DR tracker tonight. Thanks everyone. :pray:
